passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be unclean for seven days, as she is during the days of her menstruation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “A woman may become pregnant.
A woman may give birth to a son.
If a woman gives birth to a son, she will be unclean for seven days.
She will be unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her menstruation.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אִשָּׁה֙ כִּ֣י תַזְרִ֔יעַ וְיָלְדָ֖ה זָכָ֑ר וְטָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים כִּימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖הּ תִּטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: And on the eighth day the flesh of the boy’s foreskin is to be circumcised.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to the Israelites through Moses.
A woman who gives birth to a son must follow these laws.
On the eighth day after the boy is born, circumcise the boy.
Cut the flesh of his foreskin.

passages.text: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days. She must not touch anything sacred or go into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are complete.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to Moses for the Israelites.
A woman who gives birth to a son must follow these rules.
She must continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days.
She must not touch anything sacred during this time.
She must not go into the sanctuary during this time.
She must wait until her days of purification are complete.
passages.original: וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב בִּדְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֑ה בְּכָל־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ לֹֽא־ תִגָּ֗ע וְאֶל־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔א עַד־ מְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽהּ׃

passages.text: If, however, she gives birth to a daughter, the woman will be unclean for two weeks as she is during her menstruation. Then she must continue in purification from her bleeding for sixty-six days.
passages.sermon:
A woman gives birth to a daughter.
She will be unclean for two weeks.
This is the same as during her menstruation.
After this, she must continue in purification from her bleeding.
She must do this for sixty-six days.
passages.original: וְאִם־ נְקֵבָ֣ה תֵלֵ֔ד וְטָמְאָ֥ה שְׁבֻעַ֖יִם כְּנִדָּתָ֑הּ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ דְּמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽה׃

passages.text: When the days of her purification are complete, whether for a son or for a daughter, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
A woman gives birth to a son or a daughter.
She must complete her days of purification.
When her days of purification are finished, she must bring offerings.
She must go to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
She must bring her offerings to the priest.
She must bring a lamb that is one year old for a burnt offering.
She must also bring a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.
passages.original: וּבִמְלֹ֣את׀ יְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֗הּ לְבֵן֮ א֣וֹ לְבַת֒ תָּבִ֞יא כֶּ֤בֶשׂ בֶּן־ שְׁנָתוֹ֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וּבֶן־ יוֹנָ֥ה אוֹ־ תֹ֖ר לְחַטָּ֑את אֶל־ פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: And the priest will present them before the LORD and make atonement for her; and she shall be ceremonially cleansed from her flow of blood. This is the law for a woman giving birth, whether to a male or to a female.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the offerings.
The priest brings them before the LORD.
The priest makes atonement for the woman.
The woman becomes clean from her flow of blood.
This is the law for a woman who gives birth.
This law applies if she gives birth to a son.
This law also applies if she gives birth to a daughter.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִיב֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְטָהֲרָ֖ה מִמְּקֹ֣ר דָּמֶ֑יהָ זֹ֤את תּוֹרַת֙ הַיֹּלֶ֔דֶת לַזָּכָ֖ר א֥וֹ לַנְּקֵבָֽה׃

passages.text: But if she cannot afford a lamb, she shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. Then the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A woman may give birth to a son or a daughter.
She must bring offerings to the priest for her purification.
If she cannot afford a lamb, she must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons.
She must bring one bird for a burnt offering.
She must bring the other bird for a sin offering.
The priest will make atonement for her.
Then she will be clean.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תִמְצָ֣א יָדָהּ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְלָקְחָ֣ה שְׁתֵּֽי־ תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶחָ֣ד לְחַטָּ֑את וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֛יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽרָה׃פ
